slug: 2025-11-21 Smart Africa - ToR for Benin National Data Strategy

facts.fact: Smart Africa Secretariat, under its workstream with GIZ, published terms of reference on 21 November 2025 (closing 17 December 2025) to recruit a consultancy to develop Benin's National Data Strategy, so a national data strategy was being prepared and not yet adopted.

systems.owner: Smart Africa Secretariat with GIZ (commissioning the drafting)
